children: Enbridge completed a bought‑deal offering of 44,735,000 common shares, raising approximately C$3.0 billion gross at C$66.85 per share.
Offered 38,900,000 shares with a full over‑allotment exercise of 5,835,000, totaling 44,735,000 shares sold.
Price per share was C$66.85, yielding aggregate gross proceeds of about C$3.0 billion before fees and expenses.
Underwriting led by RBC Dominion Securities and CIBC World Market on a bought‑deal basis with customary agreements and indemnities.
Offering made under an effective shelf registration (File No. 333-289186) with related underwriting and legal opinions filed as exhibits.
